meta.title: Retry failed webhook deliveries with backoff
meta.body:
Retries a failed webhook delivery with exponential backoff instead of dropping it. `WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (default 5) caps the attempts and `WEBHOOK_BASE_DELAY_MS` (default 500) sets the first wait, which doubles after each failure.

## Retry flow

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[POST delivery] -->|2xx| B[Done]
  A -->|error or non-2xx| C{Attempts left?}
  C -->|yes| D[Wait base delay x 2^n] --> A
  C -->|no| E[Give up]
```

## Timing

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant W as Worker
  participant E as Endpoint
  W->>E: attempt 1
  E-->>W: 503
  Note over W: wait 500 ms
  W->>E: attempt 2
  E-->>W: 200
```

baseBrief.summary: Retries a failed webhook delivery with exponential backoff instead of dropping it: up to WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS attempts, waiting WEBHOOK_BASE_DELAY_MS doubled after each failure.

changeGroups.title: Compute the backoff wait
changeGroups.summary: computeBackoffMs doubles the base delay after each failed attempt, and sleep waits that long.

changeGroups.title: Configure the retry limits
changeGroups.summary: WebhookConfig gains maxAttempts and baseDelayMs, read from WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 5) and WEBHOOK_BASE_DELAY_MS (default 500).

changeGroups.title: Retry a failed delivery
changeGroups.summary: deliver posts up to maxAttempts times, treating a thrown fetch as a failed attempt and waiting the backoff between attempts; it returns false once the attempts run out.
